english.note: Use 露出 as the all-purpose choice when something hidden becomes visible, especially a body part such as teeth.

examples.english: I bare my two front teeth when I smile.
examples.traditional: 我笑嗰陣露出兩隻門牙。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 siu3 go2 zan6 lou6 ceot1 loeng5 zek3 mun4 ngaa4

english.note: Use this when something unintentionally reveals a hidden fact, characteristic, or origin.

examples.english: His accent can unwittingly betray that he is a local.
examples.traditional: 佢講嘢嘅口音無意中露出咗佢係本地人。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 ge3 hau2 jam1 mou4 ji3 zung1 lou6 ceot1 zo2 keoi5 hai6 bun2 dei6 jan4
